Batch-duplicate a complete manifest under a target — the copy-side twin of

members.name: expandedPaths

members.name: nodes

The node objects: assigning replaces the tree (input); reading returns every node's

members.name: selectedPaths

The selected set (snapshot); assigning replaces it silently — no `selection-change` /

members.name: checkedPaths

The checked set as emitted (projected through `cascadeCheckPolicy`); assigning replaces it

members.name: pasteNodes

members.name: setRenderer

members.name: deactivate
members.description:
The host was detached (a DOM move or a removal): stop live resources only
(document listeners, observers, autoUpdate, open popups). Tree state, the
rendered rows and the scroll offset survive; activate resumes.
Idempotent.

members.name: setDisabled
members.description:
The effective disabled state (the element merges its `isDisabled` input with a disabled
`<fieldset>`): no user interaction, out of the tab order. Programmatic calls still work.

members.name: setArmed
members.description: `highlight-on-page-drag` armed state — an armed empty tree shows its drop zone.

members.name: activate
members.description: The host was re-attached: restart what deactivate stopped. Idempotent.

members.name: isArmed
members.description:
True while the tree is armed (`highlight-on-page-drag` + a node is dragged over
the page + it accepts drops). Mirrors the `armed` attribute / `:state(armed)`.

members.name: collapseAll
members.description: Settles after the collapse applied — after the rows animated out (motion).

members.name: collapseNodes
members.description: Settles after the collapse applied — after the rows animated out (motion).

members.name: filterNodes
members.description: Filter the visible tree to `term` (empty = clear); `searchOptions` go to FlexSearch.

members.name: searchNodes
members.description: The nodes matching `term` (no filtering); `searchOptions` go to FlexSearch.

members.name: activateMenuItem
members.description:
Run a menu item exactly like the built-in menu: `beforeActionCallback` (`false` cancels) →
item `onClick(detail)` → built-in action → `action` event. For `renderContextMenuCallback`:
`ctx.controller.activateMenuItem(entry.item, ctx, button, event)`. Resolves `false` when
cancelled; closing the menu is the caller's job.

members.name: insertNode
members.description: Insert one node before / after `targetPath` (as its sibling) or as its last child.

members.description: Copy one node (+ descendants) under a parent; `transform({ data, node })` may return null to skip.

members.description: Apply a batch of add / update / remove changes.

members.description: Access the underlying LTree for advanced programmatic usage.

members.name: getNodeRef
members.description: The node at `path` with its live parent and siblings.

members.name: refreshNode
members.description: Re-render the node at `path` after its data object was changed in place.

members.name: refreshSiblings
members.description: Re-sort the children of `parentPath` (`''` = the roots) by the tree's rule and re-render.

members.name: isNodeDropAllowed
members.description: Whether the node at `path` accepts drops (`getIsDropAllowedCallback` → `isDropAllowedMember`); `false` for an unknown path.

members.name: isRendering
members.description: True while a progressive render is in flight (`render-start` … `render-complete`). Read-only.

members.name: containerSize
members.description: The tree container's last measured size (`container-resize`); `null` before the first measure. Read-only.

members.name: focusedNode
members.description: The focused node (read-only — `focusNode(path)` / `clearFocus()` move it).

members.name: openContextMenu
members.description: Open the context menu for the node at `path` at viewport coordinates.

members.name: insertBranch
members.description: Insert a branch before / after `targetPath` (block order kept) or under it (`'child'`).

members.name: selectionAnchor
members.description:
The Shift-range anchor (Shift+click / Shift+Arrow extend from it); `null` = none.
Writable — e.g. an alternative renderer keeping its own range selection in sync.

members.name: toggleFocusedSelect
members.description: Toggle the focused node in / out of the selection (Ctrl+click semantics). Multiple selection mode only.

members.name: sortNodes
members.description:
Sort the children of each node (one level; `''` = the roots) by the tree's rule
(`sortCallback` → `orderMember` → display value, numeric-aware) or `options.compareCallback`;
`direction: 'desc'` reverses it. Fires `nodes-reorder` when `orderMember` values were
rewritten (unless `isSilent`). Works with `isSortingEnabled` off too.

members.name: sortAll
members.description:
Sort whole subtrees — the nodes' children at every depth; `null` / omitted = the whole
tree. Same rule / options / event as sortNodes.

members.name: insertResult
members.description: Result of the most recent data insert (successful / failed / failedDetails) — read-only state.

members.name: pasteNodes
members.description: Paste under / beside `targetPath`; `transform(ctx{ data, … })` overrides nodeInputTransformationCallback.

members.name: removeNodes
members.description: Programmatic removal (no `beforeDeleteCallback`, no `node-delete` — those belong to the user Delete command).

members.name: treeId
members.description: Stable identifier for this tree (clipboard / cross-tree operations).

members.name: idMember
members.description: Property name on a node object that holds its id.

members.name: pathMember
members.description: Property name that holds a node materialized tree path.

members.name: displayValueMember
members.description: Property name that holds a node display label.

members.name: parentPathMember
members.description: Property name holding a node parent path.

members.name: levelMember
members.description: Property name holding a node depth level.

members.name: isExpandedMember
members.description: Property name flagging whether a node is expanded.

members.name: isCheckedMember
members.description: Property name flagging whether a node is checked (checkbox).

members.name: isDraggableMember
members.description: Property name flagging whether a node is draggable.

members.name: isDropAllowedMember
members.description: Property name flagging whether a drop is allowed onto a node.

members.name: hasChildrenMember
members.description: Property name flagging that a node has children (lazy trees).

members.name: searchValueMember
members.description: Property name a node is searched against.

members.name: isSelectableMember
members.description: Property name flagging whether a node can be selected.

members.name: isCollapsibleMember
members.description: Property name flagging whether a node can be collapsed.

members.name: orderMember
members.description: Property name used to order sibling nodes.

members.name: allowedDropPositionsMember
members.description: Property name listing the drop positions allowed on a node.

members.name: iconMember
members.description: Property name that holds a per-node icon value — markup, a built-in name, a name for `renderIconCallback`, or icon-font classes (`<i class="wtv__icon {value}">`).

members.name: iconColorMember
members.description: Property name that holds a per-node icon color (applied to the .wtv__node-icon element).

members.name: expandLevel
members.description: Depth to auto-expand on load (0 = roots only, the default).

members.name: treePathSeparator
members.description: Separator between segments in a materialized tree path.

members.name: clickBehavior
members.description: What a node click does: select, expand, or expand-and-focus (default).

members.name: shouldExpandAsAccordion
members.description: Accordion mode: expanding a node collapses its siblings.

members.name: isSortingEnabled
members.description: Automatic sorting of siblings (default on). Off: the input order is kept, `addNode` appends, `insertNode` / `insertBranch` / `moveNode` / drop keep the exact position (with `orderMember` the order values are still computed). `sortNodes` / `sortAll` still sort; switching it back on re-sorts the tree.

members.name: isSorted
members.description: Hint: data is already in insert order (parents first, siblings ordered) — skips sorting the input; faster on big data.

members.name: shouldUseInternalSearchIndex
members.description: Build the internal FlexSearch index that filterNodes / searchNodes / search-term query (default on; `false` = no index, search finds nothing).

members.name: indexerBatchSize
members.description: Max nodes indexed per idle slot when building the search index (default 1000). Each slot is also time-boxed (≤16 ms, ≤8 ms when forced on a busy page), which is what keeps the UI smooth.

members.name: indexerTimeout
members.description: Idle timeout (ms) between search-index batches.

members.name: initializeIndexCallback
members.description: Factory for a custom FlexSearch Index (tokenizer, charset, …) used instead of the built-in one. JS only; a change rebuilds the index.

members.name: searchTerm
members.description: Active search/filter term.

members.name: searchResultLimit
members.description: Max matches a search / filter returns (default 1000; FlexSearch's own silent default was 100). Check `search-status-change` `detail.isLimited` to tell users the result was truncated.

members.name: filterScope
members.description: EXPERIMENTAL — which descendants of a filter match stay visible (ancestors always do): `matches` (default), `descendants` (whole subtree), `tree-depth` (whole subtree for a match at level ≥ max depth − x), `subtree-height` (whole subtree if it is ≤ x levels deep), `levels-below` (x levels under each match). x = filter-descendant-depth.

members.name: filterDescendantDepth
members.description: EXPERIMENTAL — the x for the depth-limited filter scopes. Default 1.

members.name: shouldExpandFilterDescendants
members.description: EXPERIMENTAL — expand the descendants a filter scope adds (default on). Off: they start collapsed (matches + ancestors stay expanded) — keeps a top-level match on a big tree cheap.

members.name: bodyClass
members.description: Extra class on the tree body container.

members.name: selectedNodeClass
members.description: Class applied to selected nodes.

members.name: focusedNodeClass
members.description: Class applied to the focused node.

members.name: checkedNodeClass
members.description: Class applied to checked nodes — opt-in extra styling; the checkbox is the default signal.

members.name: dragOverNodeClass
members.description: Class applied to a node being dragged over.

members.name: draggedNodeClass
members.description: Class for the dragged source row; replaces the built-in .wtv__node-content--dragged visual.

members.name: isNodeTooltipsShown
members.description: Enable hover/focus tooltips on node rows (content from getNodeTooltipCallback).

members.name: tooltipPlacement
members.description: Tooltip placement relative to the row. Default top-start.

members.name: tooltipDelay
members.description: Show/hide delay (ms). The attribute sets both; the JS property also accepts { show, hide }. Default { show: 400, hide: 100 }.

members.name: tooltipOffset
members.description: Gap from the row (or cursor), px. Default 8.

members.name: shouldTooltipFollowCursor
members.description: Anchor the tooltip to the pointer instead of the row.

members.name: iconSet
members.description: Disclosure glyph set: chevron (default) | triangle | plus-minus | arrow. Re-points the --wtv-icon-* variables via a :host([icon-set]) rule; reflected to the attribute so the CSS matches when set via the JS property.

members.name: leafIconClass
members.description: Icon class for leaf nodes.

members.name: toggleIconMode
members.description: Whether the toggle glyph rotates (single glyph, default) or swaps (expand↔collapse glyph). Reflected to the attribute so the :host([toggle-icon-mode="swap"]) CSS matches via the JS property.

members.name: scrollHighlightClass
members.description: Class flashed on a node after scrollToPath().

members.name: scrollHighlightTimeout
members.description: How long (ms) the scroll highlight stays before clearing.

members.name: nodeTitleOverflow
members.description: A too-long built-in label: `wrap` (multi-line; rows grow — avoid with virtual scroll), `ellipsis` (single-line clip, default) or `info` (ellipsis + a trailing info button on clipped rows that reveals the full label). renderNodeCallback content owns its layout.

members.name: shouldAlignNodeIcons
members.description: Reserve a fixed icon column so node labels align.

members.name: contextMenuXOffset
members.description: Horizontal offset (px) of the context menu from the pointer.

members.name: contextMenuYOffset
members.description: Vertical offset (px) of the context menu from the pointer.

members.name: isDisabled
members.description: Disable the tree like a native form control: no user interaction (check, select, expand / collapse, drag, drop, copy / cut / paste / delete, context menu, keyboard), out of the tab order, `aria-disabled="true"`, dimmed (`--wtv-disabled-tree-opacity`). Programmatic API calls still work. Re-enabling restores everything.

members.name: isReadonly
members.description: Read-only tree like a native read-only control: the user cannot change the data — no check, drag, drop, cut / paste / delete (shortcuts and built-in menu items), no sort from the menu — but the tree stays focusable and navigable: keyboard navigation, scroll, expand / collapse, selection highlight and copy work. Not dimmed. Programmatic API calls still work.

members.name: isLoading
members.description: Show the loading state.

members.name: dragDropMode
members.description: Drag-drop mode: `none` (off, default), `self` (within this tree), `cross` (between trees), or `both`.

members.name: dropZoneMode
members.description: Drop-zone visual style: floating indicator or glow (default).

members.name: dropZoneLayout
members.description: Where drop zones render relative to a node (default `around`).

members.name: dropZoneStart
members.description: Where drop zones begin. A number is a percentage of node width; a string is used as-is (`px` or `%`, e.g. "50px").

members.name: dropZoneMaxWidth
members.description: Maximum floating drop-zone width, a CSS length (`120px`, `8rem`, `30%`); a number means pixels on both paths (`drop-zone-max-width="90"` / `el.dropZoneMaxWidth = 90` → `90px`). Default `120px`.

members.name: isCopyAllowed
members.description: Allow the copy clipboard operation.

members.name: shouldAutoHandleCopy
members.description: Let the tree perform the copy itself (vs delegating to onCopy).

members.name: shouldAutoHandleMove
members.description: Let the tree perform a move drop itself (default). `false`: the tree is not mutated — `node-drop` fires and the consumer moves the nodes.

members.name: shouldAutoHandlePaste
members.description: Let the tree perform the paste itself (vs delegating to onPaste).

members.name: shouldHandleKeyboardShortcuts
members.description: Handle copy/cut/paste/delete keyboard shortcuts.

members.name: touchDragDelay
members.description: Long-press hold (ms) before a touch-drag engages (default 300).

members.name: shouldIndicateUndraggable
members.description: Built-in "can't move/drop this" feedback (🚫 badge + haptic). Default true.

members.name: isTreeDropZoneEnabled
members.description: Make the whole populated tree one drop target (drop lands target=null regardless of per-node drop rules).

members.name: labels
members.description: UI strings — a partial object (JSON attribute) of flat `<elementType>.<name>` keys (short `messages.noData` or full `web-treeview.messages.noData`), resolved per key by core `/locale`: this `labels` → the page-wide flat dictionary `window.components.locale.labels["web-treeview.<key>"]` → English (an empty string = render nothing; a key this instance did not set goes through the element `translateCallback`, then the page-wide one, first): `messages.noData` ("No data" — no nodes), `messages.noResults` ("No results found" — the search filter left nothing), `messages.dropHere` ("Drop here" — the empty-tree drop zone), `messages.loading` ("Loading…" — the loading row of a lazy context submenu), `labels.noDisplayValue` ("[N/A]" — node without a display value), `labels.dropBefore` / `labels.dropAfter` / `labels.dropChild` ("Before" / "After" / "Child" — the floating drop pads), `ariaLabels.tree` ("Tree" — aria-label of the tree body), `ariaLabels.loading` ("Loading…" — aria-label of the `isLoading` overlay), `ariaLabels.showFullLabel` ("Show full label" — the node-title-overflow="info" button), `ariaLabels.closeSheet` ("Close" — the context menu sheet / drawer close button), `menuItems.copy`, `menuItems.cut`, `menuItems.paste`, `menuItems.delete`, `menuItems.expand`, `menuItems.collapse`, `menuItems.expandSubtree`, `menuItems.collapseSubtree`, `menuItems.expandAll`, `menuItems.collapseAll`, `menuItems.sort`, `menuItems.sortSubtree`, `menuItems.sortAll` (built-in context-menu items), `menuItems.back` ("Back" — the sheet / drawer submenu back row); screen-reader announcements (core `announce()`, `""` silences one): `ariaLabels.searchResults` / `ariaLabels.searchResultsOne` ("{count} results" / "1 result" — a settled search), `ariaLabels.searchNoResults` ("No results found"), `ariaLabels.movedInto` / `ariaLabels.movedBefore` / `ariaLabels.movedAfter` / `ariaLabels.copiedInto` / `ariaLabels.copiedBefore` / `ariaLabels.copiedAfter` ("{name} moved into {target}" … — a drop the tree placed), `ariaLabels.dropItems` ("{count} items" — the `{name}` of a multi-node drop), `ariaLabels.dropTreeRoot` ("the tree" — the `{target}` of a drop on the top level), `ariaLabels.dropDenied` ("Cannot drop here: {target} does not accept dropped items"). `{name}` placeholders.

members.name: locale
members.description: BCP-47 locale for the numbers in labels (`{count}` in the `ariaLabels.searchResults` / `ariaLabels.dropItems` announcements) and the `locale` a `translateCallback` receives, or unset (the page-wide `window.components.locale`, else the browser language; `auto` = unset). The tree formats nothing else. UI strings are `labels`.

members.name: translateCallback
members.description: This tree's translation hook (core `/locale`): `({ component, key, template, params, locale }) => string | null`, `key` = the full `web-treeview.<elementType>.<name>`. Asked for every label key this instance's `labels` did not set, before the page-wide `window.components.locale.translateCallback`; `null` / `undefined` = not mine (the page-wide hook, then the page dictionary / English decide). A change re-renders the texts live.

members.name: isEmptyDropPlaceholderShown
members.description: Show a drop placeholder when the tree is empty.

members.name: shouldHighlightOnPageDrag
members.description: Arm the drop target while a tree NODE is dragged anywhere over the page (any tree): the host gets the `armed` attribute + `:state(armed)`, and an empty tree shows its drop zone at once with `--wtv-drop-placeholder-bg-armed` (the zone under the pointer keeps the engaged look). Cleared on drop anywhere, when the drag leaves the window, on Escape / `dragend`, and on disconnect. Never armed while `drag-drop-mode="none"`, disabled or read-only. One shared page listener for all instances (same option as web-dropzone).

members.name: isFlatRenderingEnabled
members.description: Render the visible nodes as a flat list (perf).

members.name: flatIndentSize
members.description: Indent per level in flat rendering, a CSS length (`20px`, `1.5rem`); a bare number means pixels (`flat-indent-size="20"` → `20px`). Default `var(--wtv-indent-size)`.

members.name: rowAnimationLimit
members.description: Rows an expand reveals animate in (part of `motion`; `--wtv-row-animation-duration: 0s` turns off just the rows). At most this many animate per expand; the rest appear at once. 0 = none.

members.name: isProgressiveRenderEnabled
members.description: Render large trees in progressive batches.

members.name: initialBatchSize
members.description: Rows rendered in the first progressive batch.

members.name: maxBatchSize
members.description: Maximum rows per progressive batch.

members.name: isVirtualScrollEnabled
members.description: Enable virtual scrolling.

members.name: virtualScrollItemHeight
members.description: Fixed row height (px) used by virtual scrolling.

members.name: virtualScrollOverscan
members.description: Extra rows rendered above/below the viewport when virtualizing.

members.name: virtualScrollContainerHeight
members.description: Height of the virtual-scroll viewport, a CSS length (`400px`, `30rem`, `50vh`); a bare number means pixels. Unset: the measured tree height (else 400px).

members.name: rangeSelectionMode
members.description: How Shift+click range selection walks the tree (default `visual`).

members.name: selectionMode
members.description: Single- (default) or multi-node selection.

members.name: navigationOverrides
members.description: Replace individual keyboard-navigation methods (navNextSibling, navPageDown, navSelectNext, …), merged over the defaults. JS property only; `null` restores the defaults.

members.name: isCheckboxesShown
members.description: Show a checkbox on each node.

members.name: checkboxMode
members.description: Checkbox interaction: `independent` (default) toggles one node; `cascade` toggles the subtree with a tristate box on branches.

members.name: cascadeCheckPolicy
members.description: Which paths the checked set EMITS in cascade mode: `rolled-up` (minimal cover), `leaves`, or `all`. Default rolled-up.

members.name: shouldClickToggleCheckbox
members.description: A node-row click also toggles its checkbox.

members.name: expandedPaths
members.description: The expanded set. Assigning (any iterable of paths) replaces it — branches not listed collapse — silently: no `expanded-change` / `tree-change` (use `expandNodes` / `collapseNodes` to announce). Attribute: a JSON array (`["1","1.2"]`) or a comma-separated list. Reading returns the live set once built. Set before the first build it replaces the `expand-level` expansion; never set, the tree keeps its own; removing the attribute (or `el.expandedPaths = undefined`) after the build collapses all.

members.name: selectedPaths
members.description: The selected set. Assigning (any iterable of paths) replaces it silently: no `selection-change` / `checked-change` / `focus-change` (use `selectNodes` / `clearSelection` to announce). Attribute: a JSON array or a comma-separated list. Reading returns the live set once built. Never set, the data's `selected` flags apply; removing the attribute (or `el.selectedPaths = undefined`) after the build clears it.

members.name: checkedPaths
members.description: The checked set (checkbox data state). Reading returns it as emitted (projected through `cascade-check-policy`) once built. Assigning (any iterable of paths) replaces it silently: no `checked-change` (use `checkNodes` / `uncheckAll` to announce). Attribute: a JSON array or a comma-separated list. Never set, the data's checked flags apply; removing the attribute (or `el.checkedPaths = undefined`) after the build clears it.

members.name: nodes
members.description: The node objects. Assigning replaces the tree (JS API); reading returns the current state once built — every node data object in tree order, mutations included (also `el.controller.nodes`).

members.name: customStyles
members.description: CSS injected into the shadow root (a full stylesheet; `@import url(…)` works) — the declarative alternative to `getCustomStylesCallback`, which wins when both are set. Comes after the page-wide `window.components["web-treeview"].customStyles`, so it overrides it.

members.name: getCustomStylesCallback
members.description: Returns a CSS string injected into the shadow root (`@import url(…)` works; an imported font is also linked in the document head). Wins over `customStyles`; comes after the page-wide layer, so it overrides it.

members.name: getDisplayValueCallback
members.description: Compute a node display label (overrides displayValueMember).

members.name: getSearchValueCallback
members.description: Compute the text a node is searched against.

members.name: getIsExpandedCallback
members.description: Whether a node starts expanded (overrides isExpandedMember).

members.name: getIsCheckedCallback
members.description: Whether a node starts checked (overrides isCheckedMember).

members.name: getIsSelectableCallback
members.description: Whether a node can be selected (overrides isSelectableMember).

members.name: getIsDraggableCallback
members.description: Whether a node is draggable (overrides isDraggableMember).

members.name: getIsDropAllowedCallback
members.description: Whether a drop onto a node is allowed (overrides isDropAllowedMember).

members.name: getIsCollapsibleCallback
members.description: Whether a node is collapsible (overrides isCollapsibleMember).

members.name: getAllowedDropPositionsCallback
members.description: Which drop positions a node allows.

members.name: getIconCallback
members.description: Compute a per-node icon value (overrides iconMember).

members.name: getIconColorCallback
members.description: Compute a per-node icon color (overrides iconColorMember).

members.name: getNodeClassCallback
members.description: Extra class(es) for a node row (`.wtv__node`).

members.name: getNodeContentClassCallback
members.description: Extra class(es) for a node content element (`.wtv__node-content`).

members.name: getNodeTooltipCallback
members.description: Tooltip content for a node — plain text or a built HTMLElement. Requires show-node-tooltips.

members.name: sortCallback
members.description: Orders the children of one parent: `ctx.nodes` are siblings — return them in the new order. Not called on the input under `sorted` (still used by addBranch / addNode / move re-sorts).

members.name: getContextMenuItemsCallback
members.description: The context-menu entries for the right-clicked node (`ctx.node`, `parent`, `siblings`): core action items (`{ id, text, icon, shortcut, onClick(detail) }`, `get*Callback(ctx)`, `children` / `getChildrenCallback`), `createMenuDivider(text?)`, or a built-in name ('copy' | 'cut' | 'paste' | 'delete' | 'expand' | 'collapse' | 'expand-subtree' | 'collapse-subtree' | 'expand-all' | 'collapse-all' | 'sort' | 'sort-subtree' | 'sort-all'). Every activation fires `action`.

members.name: renderNodeCallback

type.text: (ctx: NodeRenderCallbackContext) => string | Node | null | undefined | false

members.description: Custom content of a node row (render state on the ctx). Returns string (HTML) / Node (mounted) / `null` | `undefined` (the built-in label) / `false` (hidden). Re-run only when the node or its render state changes.

members.name: renderIconCallback

type.text: (name: string, ctx: IconRenderContext) => string | null | undefined

members.description: This tree's icon hook: maps a node's icon name (iconMember / getIconCallback) to markup. Asked after markup and the built-in names, before the page-wide `window.components.renderIconCallback`; `null` = not mine (the next rule decides), `''` = no icon. `ctx.node` + the render state.

members.name: renderEmptyStateCallback

type.text: (ctx: ContainerRenderContext) => string | Node | null | undefined | false

members.description: Custom empty-tree state. Returns string (HTML) / Node (mounted) / `null` | `undefined` (the built-in text) / `false` (hidden).

members.name: renderEmptyZoneCallback

type.text: (ctx: ContainerRenderContext) => string | Node | null | undefined | false

members.description: Custom content of the empty-tree drop zone. Returns string (HTML) / Node (mounted) / `null` | `undefined` (the built-in box) / `false` (hidden).

members.name: renderLoadingCallback
members.description: Custom render for the loading state (the `isLoading` overlay), the core shared loader hook: fill `ctx.containerElement` (already `role="status"` + `aria-label` = the `ariaLabels.loading` label); `ctx` = `{ component, context: "overlay", containerElement, element, label }`; may return a cleanup. Beats the page-wide `window.components.renderLoadingCallback`; neither set: the default `.wtv__loader` (`--wtv-loader-*` tokens).

members.name: renderHeaderCallback

type.text: (ctx: ContainerRenderContext) => string | Node | null | undefined | false

members.description: Header above the tree. Returns string (HTML) / Node (mounted) / `null` | `undefined` (empty) / `false` (hidden).

members.name: renderFooterCallback

type.text: (ctx: ContainerRenderContext) => string | Node | null | undefined | false

members.description: Footer below the tree. Returns string (HTML) / Node (mounted) / `null` | `undefined` (empty) / `false` (hidden).

members.name: renderContextMenuCallback
members.description: Take over the whole context menu: fill `ctx.containerElement` (close via `ctx.controller.closeContextMenu()`).

members.name: renderContextMenuItemCallback
members.description: Fill one context-menu item button (`ctx.buttonElement`, `ctx.menuItem`); leave it empty for the default.

members.name: beforeCopyCallback
members.description: Runs before a copy (synchronous): `false` blocks, a `string[]` replaces the paths.

members.name: beforeCutCallback
members.description: Runs before a cut (synchronous): `false` blocks, a `string[]` replaces the paths.

members.name: beforePasteCallback
members.description: Runs before a paste (synchronous): `false` blocks (no `node-paste` event), an object redirects the target / position.

members.name: beforeDeleteCallback
members.description: Runs before a delete (synchronous): `false` blocks, a `string[]` narrows the paths.

members.name: beforeDropCallback

type.text: (ctx: BeforeDropCallbackContext) => false | { position?, operation? } | DropGroup[] | void | Promise<…>

members.description: Runs before a drop (async OK): `false` blocks, an object redirects, a DropGroup[] routes it to several destinations.

members.name: beforeDragStartCallback
members.description: Set-level pre-drag interceptor (synchronous — dragstart): prune/augment/veto the dragged set.

members.name: beforeCheckboxToggleCallback
members.description: Runs before a checkbox toggle (`ctx.node`, `ctx.isChecked`, `ctx.affectedPaths`): `false` cancels, a `string[]` overrides the affected paths.

members.name: beforeExpandCallback
members.description: Runs before a node expands (toggle, keyboard, expandNodes — not expandAll / seeding / accordion): `false` keeps it collapsed; a Promise defers the expand with a loading state (lazy loading: addBranch the children, then resolve). A throw / rejection keeps it collapsed and is logged (error) through the element's logger.

members.name: beforeScrollCallback
members.description: Runs before the tree scrolls a node into view on its own (keyboard move, scrollToPath, paste reveal). Return false to skip the scroll, or options to replace the defaults. Sync.

members.name: beforeKeydownCallback
members.description: Runs before the built-in keyboard handling (synchronous): return `false` to suppress it for this key. Drive the tree via `ctx.controller`.

members.name: beforeActionCallback
members.description: Runs before a context-menu item activates: `false` cancels its onClick, the `action` event and the built-in.

members.name: nodeOutputTransformationCallback
members.description: OUTPUT (egress) transform — clean/redact `ctx.data` as a node leaves the source (copy/cut/copy-drop).

members.name: nodeInputTransformationCallback
members.description: INPUT (ingress) transform — derive ids/values from `ctx.data` as a node lands (paste/copy-drop); return null to skip.

members.name: menuPresentation
members.description: How the component's context / dropdown menus open: 'auto' (default — a bottom sheet on a phone, the floating menu elsewhere), 'floating', 'sheet' (bottom sheet) or 'drawer' (full-height side panel on `menu-side`). Per device / width through the responsive rules.

members.name: menuSide
members.description: The edge a 'drawer' menu slides in from: 'start' (default — left in LTR, right in RTL) or 'end'.

members.name: shouldDefer
members.description: Hold the first build (core, SPEC §6.3): while set when the element first connects, nothing is built and every input, callback and listener assigned meanwhile accumulates; `release()` (or removing the attribute) then builds once. Latched after the first build.

members.name: themeSource
members.description: Where this element reads its theme from instead of the page (core, SPEC §12.10): a CSS selector (nearest matching ancestor, else the first match), `'closest'` (the nearest ancestor carrying a theme signal), or (property only) an `Element`. Unset = the page.

members.name: motion
members.description: Motion level (core, SPEC §12.16): `auto` (default — inherit: the nearest `data-motion` ancestor (a section), else the page level `window.components.motion` / `<html data-motion>`; closest wins), `none` (no transitions, instant scrolling), `snappy` (short) or `smooth` (longer). Sets the shared `--base-duration-*` / `--base-scroll-behavior` tokens on the element through `data-motion`; the OS reduced-motion setting always wins.

members.name: responsive
members.description: Instance responsive rules (core, SPEC §6.7): partial configs on three axes — `breakpoint` (keyed by the window-width bucket), `container` (keyed by the component's own width: `narrow` / `medium` / `wide`, lines `--base-container-narrow` / `-medium`, 480 / 768) and `device` (keyed by device class `mobile` / `tablet` / `desktop`; a mouse device is `desktop` at any width), applied in that order (a later axis wins). An object or a JSON attribute, e.g. `{"device":{"tablet":{"presentation":"modal"}},"breakpoint":{"mobile":{…}}}`. Beats page rules (`window.components.responsive*`) and values set on the element; never reflects. An entry of `null` ignores the page rules while it matches.

members.name: responsiveCallback
members.description: Instance computed responsive rule (core, SPEC §6.7): `(ctx) => partial config | null | undefined`, ctx `{ env, deviceClass, breakpoint, container, width, element, component, config }` (`config` = base; `width` = its own box). Runs after `responsive` (wins key by key); re-runs on environment flips, throttled viewport-width and own-width changes, rule and config changes. `null` ignores every page rule.

members.name: isReady

members.name: whenReady

members.name: release
members.description: Build an element held by `defer` (SPEC §6.3), with everything assigned meanwhile.

members.name: setAttributes

members.name: batch

members.name: flush

members.name: whenSettled

members.name: destroy

events.name: node-click
events.description: A node was clicked (a checkbox toggle is not a click — see `checked-change`). `detail`: the node with `path`, `parent`, `siblings`. Twin: `onNodeClick(detail)`.

events.name: node-double-click
events.description: A node was double-clicked. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDoubleClick(detail)`.

events.name: node-expand
events.description: A node expanded (toggle, keyboard, `expandNodes`, after any `beforeExpandCallback` load; NOT `expandAll` / expand-level seeding — those only fire `expanded-change`). `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeExpand(detail)`.

events.name: node-collapse
events.description: A node collapsed (toggle, keyboard, `collapseNodes`, an accordion sibling; NOT `collapseAll`). `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeCollapse(detail)`.

events.name: node-copy
events.description: Nodes were copied. `detail`: `{ operation, paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onNodeCopy(detail)`.

events.name: node-cut
events.description: Nodes were cut. `detail`: `{ operation, paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onNodeCut(detail)`.

events.name: node-paste
events.description: A paste ran (not fired when `beforePasteCallback` blocked it). `detail`: the PasteResult (`success`, `count`, `skipped`, `error?`, `entries?`, …). Twin: `onNodePaste(detail)`.

events.name: node-delete
events.description: Nodes were deleted. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }` (pre-removal snapshots). Twin: `onNodeDelete(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-start
events.description: A node drag started. `detail`: the drag context (`event`, `dragged`). Twin: `onNodeDragStart(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-over
events.description: A node was dragged over. `detail`: the drag context. Twin: `onNodeDragOver(detail)`.

events.name: node-drop
events.description: A drop completed. `detail`: `{ source, target, dragged, dropped, position, operation, event }`. Twin: `onNodeDrop(detail)`.

events.name: node-drag-reject
events.description: A locked node was long-pressed / an undraggable drag was attempted. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDragReject(detail)`.

events.name: node-drop-reject
events.description: A drop was rejected by the target. `detail`: the node context. Twin: `onNodeDropReject(detail)`.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: The selected set changed. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onSelectionChange(detail)`.

events.name: checked-change
events.description: The checked (checkbox) set changed. `detail`: `{ paths, nodes }`. Twin: `onCheckedChange(detail)`.

events.name: focus-change
events.description: The focused node changed. `detail`: `{ focusedNode }`. Twin: `onFocusChange(detail)`.

events.name: expanded-change
events.description: The expanded set changed (toggle, keyboard, expandNodes / collapseNodes, expandAll / collapseAll, accordion, data changes) — one event per change: synchronously right after an expand / collapse (after its `node-expand` / `node-collapse`), on the next microtask after a data change. `detail`: `{ paths }` = the whole new set (same as `expandedPaths`). Not fired for `{ isSilent: true }` operations nor for assigning `expandedPaths`. Twin: `onExpandedChange(detail)`.

events.name: nodes-reorder
events.description: A sort (`sortNodes` / `sortAll` / the `sort*` menu items) with a `compareCallback` or `direction: "desc"` rewrote the `orderMember` values (10, 20, 30…) of the children of one parent — one event per parent; never without `orderMember`. `detail`: `{ parentPath, nodes, changes: [{ path, oldOrder, newOrder }] }`. Twin: `onNodesReorder(detail)`.

events.name: tree-change
events.description: The data / structure changed — add / insert / update / move / remove, `applyChanges`, add / insert / replace / removeBranch, paste, drop, duplicate, sort. One event per change (a compound op such as a multi-node drop fires once), on the microtask after it. Not for expand / select / check / focus nor for loading `nodes`; read the new state from `controller.nodes`. `detail`: the context only. Twin: `onTreeChange(detail)`.

events.name: action
events.description: A context-menu item was activated. `detail`: `action` (built-in name or `custom`), `id`, `item`, `source: "context-menu"`, `node` / `path` / `parent` / `siblings`, `sourceEvent`, `triggerElement`. Fires after the item’s `onClick`, before the built-in. Twin: `onAction(detail)`.

events.name: render-start
events.description: A progressive render began (`isRendering` turns true). `detail`: the context only. Twin: `onRenderStart(detail)`.

events.name: render-progress
events.description: A progressive-render batch finished. `detail`: `{ pending, processed }`. Twin: `onRenderProgress(detail)`.

events.name: render-complete
events.description: The progressive render finished (`isRendering` turns false). `detail`: `{ pending, processed }`. Twin: `onRenderComplete(detail)`.

events.name: index-progress
events.description: The async search index filled another batch, and once more with `isComplete: true` at the end — search / filter results are partial until then. `detail`: `{ processed, total, isComplete }`. Twin: `onIndexProgress(detail)`.

events.name: search-status-change
events.description: A filter was applied or cleared (also the automatic re-filter when indexing completes). `detail`: `{ searchTerm, matchCount, isLimited, limit, isIndexing }` — `isLimited` = more matched than `search-result-limit` and the rest were cut off. Twin: `onSearchStatusChange(detail)`.

events.name: container-resize
events.description: The tree container was resized (also once when the tree starts observing). `detail`: `{ size: { width, height }, deviceClass }` — `size` is also `el.containerSize`. Twin: `onContainerResize(detail)`.

events.name: ready
events.description: Fired once after the first live build (core, SPEC §6.3), on the microtask after it; also the `ready` attribute, `:state(ready)`, `isReady` and `whenReady()`. Twin callback `onReady`.

events.name: input-rejected
events.description: Fired when a written value is refused (core, SPEC §6): an invalid attribute or property value, or an unknown `setAttributes()` key. The element warns and keeps its previous value. Detail `{ configKey, attribute?, value, reason?, kept, source }`. Twin callback `onInputRejected`.
